verdict.rationale: Mercury's site explicitly claims you can "Find any transaction, vendor, or card, or jump straight to creating payments, transfers, and more — all from one universal search bar," which matches the story almost word for word. Supporting docs confirm one-click payments by permitted users and payment rails such as ACH and wire. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how universal search works (scope, filters, result behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the search-to-payment flow.
